title: Wind Turbine Blade Sleeve System
abstract: A wind turbine blade bushing system for arrangement in a root end of a wind turbine blade is described. The wind turbine blade bushing system comprises a threaded element for holding a mounting bolt for a wind turbine blade, the threaded element being formed of a first material; an anchoring element for arrangement at the root end of the wind turbine, wherein the anchoring element functions to at least partially retain the threaded element in the wind turbine blade, the anchoring element being formed of a second material. The first material has a higher strength and fracture toughness than the second material.
